blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. We start slow. You can do it!

A supplier is a company that sells to us. A buyer is a company that buys from us. Together, suppliers and buyers make the supply chain work.

Today you learn 5 important words: supplier, buyer, partner, contract and price. You also practise subject pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Pronouns make your speech shorter. A good partner is gold.

items.q: What does a supplier do?
options: It sets the price for buyers
It signs the contract for us
items.why: "A supplier is a company that sells to us."

items.q: What does a buyer do?
items.why: "A buyer is a company that buys from us."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn 5 important words."

items.q: The text says pronouns make your speech shorter. This suggests that…
options: you should say every name many times
you can use 'they' instead of repeating names
you must avoid pronouns in a meeting
pronouns are not useful at work
items.why: Inferência: se o pronome deixa a fala mais curta, ele substitui a repetição do nome (ex.: 'they').

items.q: "A good partner is gold." The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: gold is cheaper than a contract
a good partner has real value
items.why: Inferência: 'is gold' é elogio — um bom parceiro é valioso.

blocks.instruction: Ouça a colega apresentando os parceiros para um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the team. Let me show you our main partners. It is easy. I use pronouns, so my speech is short.

This is Green Farm. They are a supplier. They sell coffee to us. Their price is good, and the contract is clear. We like them a lot.

This is Ana. She is our buyer contact at Star Foods. She buys coffee from us. She is kind, and she answers fast. You can call her any day.

And this is Mr. Cruz. He is a new partner. He works with a small supplier. He is polite, but he is still new, so we go slow with him.

So, remember: a supplier sells to us, and a buyer buys from us. The contract protects both sides. The price is always key. And a good partner is gold. You will learn all the pronouns soon. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is Green Farm?
items.why: "This is Green Farm. They are a supplier."

items.q: What does Ana do?
items.why: "She is our buyer contact… She buys coffee from us."

items.q: Why does the speaker use pronouns?
items.why: "I use pronouns, so my speech is short."

items.q: The speaker says "we go slow with him" about Mr. Cruz. This suggests that…
options: Mr. Cruz is a big supplier
Mr. Cruz will leave the team
Mr. Cruz is new, so they are careful
items.why: Inferência: ele é novo parceiro, então o time age com cuidado.

items.q: How does the speaker feel about the team's partners?
items.why: Inferência: 'Welcome', 'We like them a lot', 'a good partner is gold' — tom positivo e acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Green Farm is our best supplier." A supplier is a company that…
items.why: Supplier = fornecedor: a empresa que vende para nós.

items.q: "Star Foods is a big buyer." A buyer is a company that…
items.why: Buyer = comprador: a empresa que compra de nós.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We sign a ___ so both sides are safe."
items.why: Contract = contrato: protege os dois lados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is good, so we pay a fair value."
items.why: Price = preço: o valor que pagamos.

items.q: "Mr. Cruz is a new partner." A partner is…
options: a person or company you work with
items.why: Partner = parceiro: pessoa ou empresa com quem você trabalha.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com fornecedores e compradores. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the contract." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new price next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = começar a usar, lançar.

items.q: "The buyer pushed back on the price." It means the buyer…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, não concordar.

items.q: "They said yes, but they did not follow through." It means they…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim (aqui, não levaram).

items.q: "Let's set up a call with the supplier." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = marcar, organizar.
